title: He is taller | Take medicine | My hair is long
caption:
3 common English mistakes - kya aap bhi karte ho?

❌ He is more taller  ✅ He is taller
❌ Eat medicine  ✅ Take medicine
❌ My hair are long  ✅ My hair is long
